infirmary.text:
```They say that at night, when there are supposedly no overnight patients in the infirmary — you will sometimes hear a ghoulish, almost inhumane cry come from the clinic. All the way at the end, where the last bed lies with its curtains drawn shut… it continues to cry…``` 
The infirmary looks the same as it always does. Chairs, tables, medicine cabinets.  A line of beds on one side of the room, all of them with curtains for privacy if needed. They’re all drawn open — all of them, except the last one at the end of the infirmary. Just like the ghost story said, the curtains are drawn shut.

What will you do?

choices.label: Go to the head nurse's table

bed1.text:
You look through the line of beds — 

There’s a dead body on one of them. 

(Although, upon closer inspection… It's obviously fake. A senior had planted them there as a Night of Veils prank on the first years.)

choices.label: Go to the head nurse's table

bed2.text: The beds are all neat and undisturbed, ready to house its next patient. The pillows all fluffed, the blankets nice and think. It looks sooo comfy. Surely, you won't get scolded if you nap here, right...?

choices.label: Go to the head nurse's table

bed3.text:
There’s a lump underneath the blanket on one of the beds… unveiling the blanket reveals…. candy?!

You collect {{d6}} pieces of candy!

choices.label: Go to the head nurse's table

bed4.text:
As you move through the many beds, checking each one, you suddenly hear a creaking noise, as if someone was moving on top of one of the beds behind you. The ones that you just checked. Wasn't it empty just a few seconds ago?

It creaks again. Closer. Louder.

When you turn around, it's silent.

choices.label: Go to the head nurse's table

bed5.text:
You check the beds, when you suddenly feel a breeze hit you. Cold...

Looking up, you realize it's becase one window is open. That's odd. You take a brief look outside, taking note of the forest trees, before closing it.

choices.label: Go to the head nurse's table

bed6.text:
You hear a noise, but before you can do anything – like hide under the table or make your escape, you hear the head nurse’s voice behind you.

“...Hello. Care to explain what you’re doing?”

As you don’t seem in need of a heal, they kindly tell you to leave, and so you do.

cabinets.text: The cabinets are locked. How anti-climactic…

choices.label: Go to the head nurse's table

table.text: You find scattered pieces of paper, prescription notes, and a few files from the head nurse written in classic doctor gibberish that is way too hard to understand.

choices.label: Go to the head nurse's table

lastbed.text: You find— nothing. Just an empty bed. The cries you thought you were hearing? There’s a vent by the wall, where the wind blows just enough to create a strange whistling sound. Ah… perhaps it was this all along?
